alternative_labels: personal information; personally identifiable information; PII; your information
definition: Data that relates to an identified or identifiable person.
scope_note: Includes data a policy calls non-personal or anonymous if this vocabulary classifies it as personal (see CQ14).

alternative_labels: location information; geolocation; location
definition: Personal data that describes where a person or their device is, at any level of accuracy.
scope_note: Covers both precise and approximate location (PL-003, PL-004).

alternative_labels: GPS location; exact location; precise geolocation; GPS coordinates
definition: Location data accurate enough to identify a specific place, such as GPS coordinates from a device.
scope_note: Use only when the policy refers to exact or device-derived location; otherwise use PL-004.
evidence: Uber rider notice: collects precise location if allowed in phone settings

alternative_labels: coarse location; general location; IP-based location; city-level location
definition: Location data that identifies only a general area, such as a city or region, often inferred from an IP address.
scope_note: Use when the policy says location is estimated or general rather than exact.
evidence: Uber rider notice: determines approximate location

alternative_labels: contact details; contact info; email address; phone number; postal address
definition: Personal data used to reach a person, such as an email address, phone number, or postal address.

alternative_labels: user-generated content; customer content; your content; posts; messages; uploaded photos
definition: Content that a person creates, uploads, or sends through a service, such as posts, messages, photos, recordings, or files.
scope_note: Zoom's 'Customer Content' maps here. Keep separate from usage data (PL-008).
evidence: Zoom terms s.10.1 (Customer Content); Uber rider notice (user content)

alternative_labels: advertising identifier; advertising ID; device ID; unique device identifier; IP address
definition: An identifier tied to a device or browser that lets a service or its partners recognise that device over time.
scope_note: IP address is listed here as an identifier; if a policy uses it only to estimate location, also tag PL-004.
evidence: Uber rider notice (device data: advertising identifiers, IP address)

alternative_labels: activity data; telemetry; diagnostic data; service generated data; product usage data
definition: Data about how a person interacts with a service, such as features used, pages viewed, searches, and crashes.
scope_note: Zoom's 'Service Generated Data' maps here, not to user content (PL-006).
evidence: Zoom terms s.10.5; Uber rider notice (usage data)

alternative_labels: providing the service; operating the service; to provide our services
definition: The purpose of using data to deliver, maintain, or operate the service the person asked for.
evidence: Uber rider notice: 'To provide our services'

alternative_labels: targeted advertising; personalized ads; ad personalization; cross-context behavioral advertising
definition: The purpose of using data to select, show, or measure advertisements.
scope_note: Under CCPA, 'sharing' means disclosure for targeted advertising (see PL-015).
evidence: Uber US notice; Uber rider notice (marketing and advertising)

alternative_labels: promotional communications; marketing emails; promotions
definition: The purpose of using data to promote a service's own or partners' products, other than by showing advertisements.
scope_note: In DPV, Advertising is a narrower kind of Marketing.

alternative_labels: training AI models; training machine learning models; training large language models; model improvement
definition: The purpose of using data to train, fine-tune, or improve machine learning or artificial intelligence models.
scope_note: Tag only when the sentence mentions models, machine learning, or AI. Vague wording such as 'improve our services' alone goes to PL-013 or PL-009.
evidence: Zoom terms s.10.2; Uber rider notice (research and development); Uber US notice (LLM training question)

alternative_labels: product development; research; developing new features
definition: The purpose of using data to research, develop, or improve products and services.
scope_note: Use PL-012 instead when the policy explicitly refers to training models.
evidence: Uber rider notice: 'For research and development'

alternative_labels: gather; obtain; receive
definition: The action of a service obtaining data from a person, their device, or another source.

alternative_labels: disclose; provide to; make available to; transfer to
definition: The action of a service making data available to another party.
scope_note: General sense of making data available. For California's narrower legal meaning use Sharing (CCPA), PL-107.
evidence: Uber US notice; Uber rider notice (data sharing and disclosure)

alternative_labels: selling data; sale of data; monetising data
definition: The action of providing data to another party in exchange for payment or another benefit.
scope_note: Legal meanings differ by law; for California's broader meaning use Sale (CCPA), PL-106.

alternative_labels: partner; vendor; business partner; external company
definition: An organisation, other than the service and the person, that receives data from the service.
scope_note: Excludes the service's own subsidiaries and affiliates.
evidence: Uber rider notice (service providers and business partners)

alternative_labels: ad network; ad intermediary; advertiser; marketing partner; ad technology vendor
definition: A third party that receives data in order to show, target, or measure advertising.
evidence: Uber rider notice (ad intermediaries, ad and marketing partners); Uber US notice

alternative_labels: opt out; turn off; disable; unselect a setting
definition: A control that lets a person stop a specific use or sharing of their data while continuing to use the service.
scope_note: Record what the opt-out applies to (for example, AI model training or advertising).
evidence: Uber US notice ('Data Sharing' setting); Uber rider notice (privacy settings)

preferred_label: Right to opt out of sale or sharing
alternative_labels: Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information; right to opt out
definition: A legal right under some US state laws, including the CCPA, to stop a business from selling or sharing one's personal information.
scope_note: A legal right, unlike PL-019, which is a control a service offers. Applies to Sale (CCPA) and Sharing (CCPA).

alternative_labels: objection to processing
definition: A legal right under GDPR to object to the processing of one's personal data for certain purposes.
scope_note: Applies in the EEA, UK and Switzerland; link to the GDPR in the ontology stage.
mapping_status: check DPV EU-GDPR extension for identifier
evidence: Uber rider notice (objections, restrictions and complaints)

alternative_labels: individual; user; person; you
definition: The individual whom personal data is about.
scope_note: Each law has its own term for this role; see PL-111 to PL-113.

alternative_labels: the company; the organisation responsible; we; us
definition: The organisation that decides why and how personal data is processed.
scope_note: Each law has its own term for this role; see PL-108 to PL-110.

alternative_labels: sensitive data; sensitive information
definition: Personal data that needs extra protection because its misuse could seriously harm the person.
scope_note: Laws disagree on what counts; compare PL-104 and PL-105.

definition: Under GDPR, any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.

alternative_labels: personal info
definition: Under the CCPA, information that identifies or could reasonably be linked to a particular consumer or household.
scope_note: Broader than PL-101 in one respect: it can cover a household, not only an individual.

alternative_labels: digital personal data
definition: Under India's DPDP Act, data about an individual who is identifiable by or in relation to that data.
scope_note: The Act applies to personal data in digital form, including data digitised after collection.

alternative_labels: special category data
definition: Under GDPR, personal data needing extra protection, such as health, biometric, or religious data.
scope_note: closeMatch PL-105 (CCPA), but the lists differ: precise geolocation is sensitive under the CCPA and is not a GDPR special category.

alternative_labels: SPI
definition: Under the CCPA, a defined set of personal information needing extra protection, including precise geolocation.
scope_note: closeMatch PL-104 (GDPR); see the note there on how the lists differ. Links to Precise location (PL-003).

alternative_labels: sell; selling
definition: Under the CCPA, disclosing personal information to a third party for money or other valuable consideration.
scope_note: Broader than the everyday meaning of selling: 'other valuable consideration' can count, not only money.
evidence: Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.140; Uber US notice

alternative_labels: share; cross-context behavioral advertising
definition: Under the CCPA, disclosing personal information to a third party for cross-context behavioral advertising.
scope_note: Narrower than the everyday meaning of sharing: it applies only to that advertising purpose (PL-010).
evidence: Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.140; Uber US notice

alternative_labels: data controller
definition: Under GDPR, the body that determines the purposes and means of processing personal data.
Under the CCPA, a for-profit entity that decides why and how consumers' personal information is processed and meets the Act's size or data thresholds.
scope_note: Narrower than PL-108 because of the thresholds: a small company may be a GDPR controller but not a CCPA business.

definition: Under India's DPDP Act, the person or organisation that determines the purpose and means of processing personal data.
Under GDPR, the identified or identifiable natural person whom personal data is about.

alternative_labels: California consumer
definition: Under the CCPA, a natural person who is a California resident.
scope_note: Narrower than PL-111: limited to California residents.

definition: Under India's DPDP Act, the individual to whom the personal data relates.
scope_note: Can include a parent or lawful guardian acting for a child; check the Act's definition.
